doc: The Long Dark's four survival needs, carried into Spore. Values are percent of the meter (0-100). Rates are per in-game hour; timing.json maps game hours to real seconds. condition_loss_per_hour_when_empty is the Long Dark rule for that need at 0%.

rows.label: Warmth
rows.source: TLD wiki Needs: freezing costs 20% condition/hour (warmth drain itself comes from temperature.json)

rows.label: Calories
rows.source: TLD wiki Needs: starving costs 1% condition/hour; TLD burns ~100 cal/h at rest and ~200 cal/h moving of a 2500 store (4%/8%)

rows.label: Thirst
rows.source: TLD wiki Needs: dehydration costs 2% condition/hour; meter empties in about a day

rows.label: Fatigue
rows.source: TLD wiki Needs: exhaustion costs 1% condition/hour
